annotations.text: Sub-project #2 — Roster & standings. This replaces the foundation's 'Season mode — coming soon' placeholder as the #/league/{key} view for a drafted league. Player values are rest-of-season VOR (season-total projection minus games played), through a swappable interface #4 can replace.

REDRAFT (leading candidate): two-panel. LEFT = your team — power-rank vs standings, positional-strength bars (rank /12), full roster by slot with ROS VOR, a 'thin at X' callout. RIGHT = league power ranking — position tabs (Overall/QB/RB/WR/TE), Starters-only vs Full-roster toggle, and a Delta column (power-rank spot minus standings spot). Everything visible at once; each panel is a bit dense.

DYNASTY: same two-panel, but the RIGHT side splits into two stacked rankings — Power ranking (players) on top, Draft capital below (per-year pick chips, traded picks amber with 'via <team>', slot = original team's projected finish). Side-by-side per your ask: read 'good roster / weak picks' vs 'thin roster / loaded picks' directly. Blended score is the marked fast-follow. Sleeper dynasty/keeper only.

ALTERNATIVE layout: sub-tabs (Rankings / My roster) instead of two panels. Each section gets full width — more columns fit (Start VOR + Bench VOR + PF + PA + Delta all at once) — but you can't see your roster and the league ranking together. Trade-off: density vs. glanceability.
